reviewer: Codex: front and side diagnostic sheets plus final light/dark 32-frame sheets inspected
limits: Local procedural review, not physical-device or biomechanical certification. Body clearance checks sample skin vertices; not exhaustive mesh collision tests.

checks.exercise: Block-supported deadlift from below knees to standing.
checks.equipment: Two equal blocks support the plate bottoms; bar and plates fully visible.
checks.setup: Both plates contact blocks at start and finish; no standing on blocks.
checks.hands: Long arms and overhand grips outside legs remain aligned to shaft.
checks.feet: Both feet stay fixed between blocks; measured drift below 6e-15.
checks.movement: Controlled lift and return; support gap starts at zero and remains nonnegative; no backward lean at top.

checks.exercise: Deadlift starting with shaft supported on rack pins below knees.
checks.equipment: Rack, equal-height safety pins and barbell visible in both themes; camera changed to reveal torso and face.
checks.setup: Shaft rests on pins with plates clear of floor; shaft stays between rack posts.
checks.hands: Both hands stay outside legs and aligned to bar; arms stay long.
checks.feet: Both feet planted inside rack without stepping.
checks.movement: Bar rises clear of pins and returns to zero support gap without penetration; sampled body/shaft clearance positive.

checks.exercise: Yielding isometric hold with lifted bar below knees, followed by return to floor.
checks.equipment: Barbell with two plates; no pins or blocks depicted.
checks.setup: Plates begin at sole level; hip-width stance and neutral trunk.
checks.hands: Long arms and aligned overhand grips hold bar steady.
checks.feet: Both feet stay fixed throughout lift, hold and descent.
checks.movement: Four-second hold with zero bar drift, 0.783 model units below knees; returns without standing fully or bouncing.
